name: MU_ParkingPermit_GetPaymentToken
description: Serverless API. Receives a registrationId and permitType, looks up the fee server-side, calls Authorize.net getHostedPaymentPageRequest, and returns the one-time hosted payment form token plus the form URL. The caller (Experience card / EIP task) POSTs the token to the form URL to open the Authorize.net hosted payment page. Default is redirect mode (new tab, A.net shows the receipt); pass the communicatorUrl parameter to switch to embedded-iframe mode instead.

parameters.name: authNetLoginId
parameters.label: Authorize.net API Login ID
parameters.description: Authorize.net API Login ID (Account > Security Settings > API Credentials & Keys).

parameters.name: authNetTransactionKey
parameters.label: Authorize.net Transaction Key
parameters.description: Authorize.net Transaction Key. Stored here so it never reaches the browser.

parameters.name: merchantName
parameters.label: Merchant Name
parameters.description: Merchant name displayed on the hosted payment page.

parameters.name: communicatorUrl
parameters.label: IFrame Communicator URL (optional)
parameters.description: Leave blank for redirect mode (recommended for Experience cards: the hosted page opens in a new tab and shows the Authorize.net receipt). If you can host an IFrameCommunicator.html on the same origin as the embedding page, set its URL here to switch to embedded-iframe mode (sets showReceipt=false).

registrationId.title: Registration ID
registrationId.description: Parking registration id; becomes the Authorize.net invoiceNumber (max 20 chars).

permitType.title: Permit Type
permitType.description: Key into the server-side fee schedule (e.g. full-year, fall, spring, summer, motorcycle).

formUrl.title: URL to POST the token to
